title: An elementary proof of symmetrization postulate in quantum mechanics for a system of particles
summary: According to symmetrization postulate for a system of identical particles, wave function has to be completely symmetric or completely anti-symmetric. In this paper we want to mathematically justify this postulate ignoring the spin part of wave function in three dimension.
